//: Single-page app: the router owns every path, but Vercel serves static
files, so only / exists on disk. Without this rewrite, opening /home or
/amigos directly — or just refreshing — returns 404, which is also where
every auth redirect lands. Vite's dev server does this fallback on its
own, so the bug only ever shows up once deployed.
Real files win before rewrites are consulted, so /assets/* is unaffected.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a changed file is a changed URL and this can never serve something stale.
index.html is the one file whose name never changes; caching it would pin people to an old build.
